# Western Illinois University

> Western Illinois University serves students across Macomb and Quad Cities campuses with comprehensive academic programs, student services, and online degree options.

WIU is a public university offering undergraduate and graduate programs through residential campuses in Macomb, Illinois and the Quad Cities region, as well as accredited online programs for working adults. The university provides extensive student support services, library resources, and international opportunities through its Center for Global Studies.

## Admissions & Enrollment

- [Apply Now - WIU](https://www.wiu.edu/apply): Undergraduate and transfer application portal for WIU admissions.
- [Campus Tours & Events - WIU](https://www.wiu.edu/visit): Campus tours, virtual tours, and visit registration for prospective students.
- [Parents & Families - WIU](https://www.wiu.edu/parents_and_family): Resources and events for WIU parents and family members.

## Academics & Programs

- [Course Offerings - WIU](https://www.wiu.edu/registrar/courses.php): Browse thousands of on-campus and online courses at WIU.
- [Online Degree Programs & Courses - WIU](https://www.wiu.edu/online): Accredited online degree programs for working adults and career changers.
- [Center for Global Studies - WIU](https://www.wiu.edu/global_studies): International student services, study abroad, and cultural activities at WIU.

## Campuses

- [Right Here at Home: Macomb's Campus and Community - WIU](https://www.wiu.edu/macomb): Overview of WIU's main residential Macomb campus and facilities.
- [Western Illinois University Quad Cities - WIU](https://www.wiu.edu/qc): WIU Quad Cities campus with undergraduate and graduate programs.

## Student Resources & Services

- [Student/Alumni Records System (STARS) - WIU](https://www.wiu.edu/stars): STARS system for student records, registration, grades, and financial aid access.
- [Western Illinois University Libraries - WIU](https://www.wiu.edu/libraries): University library services, collections, research guides, and digital resources.
- [A to Z Index - WIU](https://www.wiu.edu/table_of_contents): A-to-Z directory and site map for WIU campus resources and services.

## Account Access & Authentication

- [Western Illinois University - CAS – Central Authentication Service](https://www.wiu.edu/portal): CAS login portal for WIU students, faculty, and staff account access.
- [CAS - Central Authentication Service Login](https://www.wiu.edu/email): Email and account login portal for WIU community members.

## About WIU

- [About Western Illinois University - WIU](https://www.wiu.edu/about): Overview of WIU history, mission, campuses, and institutional identity.
